goal: the campaign «Лохмотья Короля» (Tatters of the King, official Russian 7e edition) playable from the base: campaign, prologue and twelve chapters as stages, scenes, places, characters, items, handouts, organizations, maps with spots, tables (Р-228).
extra:
## This work (Р-228) The campaign «Лохмотья Короля» (Tim Wiseman, Chaosium 2006; official Russian 7e edition, 359 pages, a text PDF made from a Word file) goes into the base whole, like «Маски Ньярлатхотепа» (models). Your unit is one part of it. **Printed page = physical page**: the PDF prints no page numbers (`pages.py` shows both, they are equal); write `printed_page` = `physical_page`. Chapter title pages are pictures (36 Book I, 159 Book II, 193 Book III); the Russian text gives no chapter titles — take `name.ru` from the Russian text if it names the chapter anywhere (grep «глав»), else translate the English title (below) and flag `translated`. Each chapter ends with «Краткое содержание главы» and the statblocks of its cast — they belong to that chapter. The English 6e original `C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\1_Библиотека\Кампании\Лохмотья Короля (Tatters of the King)\[EN 6e] Call of Cthulhu - 1920 - Tatters of the King.pdf` (240 pages, `pdftotext -layout -f N -l N`) is **only for names**: `name.en`, English slugs, the spelling of people and places. Numbers, statblocks and text come from the Russian 7e book. The Russian text is the source (no `translated` flag), but it is uneven: terms of the base win (Р-184: `python tools/terms.py `; бьякхи, Тёмная молодь, Шантак, Ми-Го… as in the shared records; Russian forms of this book that differ go to `aliases` through proposals); characteristic abbreviations, skill names and «рассудок» (the book mixes «здравомыслие», «рассудок», «РАС», «ВОЛ», «следователи/сыщики») — as in the Russian Keeper Rulebook (`docs/conventions.md`). The book spells some names two ways (Хилари/Хиллари, Малкольм/Малькольм, Гоатсвуд/Гоутсвуд): take the form of the cast list on pp. 9–10, the other one goes to `aliases`. ### Fixed ids (all units use them; a reference to a record another unit is still writing is expected to fail `check.py` until that unit lands — list such refs in the report, do not drop them) - Campaign: `lokhmotya-korolya-ru/scenario/tatters-of-the-king` (unit intro): `summary`, `keeper_info`, `hook`, `advice`, `steps` grouped by Book I «Безумец» / Book II «Британские боги» / Book III «Монастырь», `refs`, `conclusion`, `tables`. - Stages — scenario records with `part_of` = the campaign and `order`: `…/scenario/opening-night` (1, Prologue «Opening Night», intro), `madman` (2, ch. 1 «The Madman»), `walk-in-the-park` (3, ch. 2 «A Walk in the Park»), `springer-mound` (4, ch. 3 «Springer Mound & the Canal»), `flight-north` (5, ch. 4 «The Flight North»), `carcosa` (6, ch. 5 «To Walk on the Earth in Carcosa»), `talk-of-goatswood` (7, ch. 6 «Talk of Goatswood»), `nugs-farm` (8, ch. 7 «Nug's Farm»), `brothers-of-the-yellow-sign` (9, ch. 8 «The Brothers of the Yellow Sign»), `viceroy-of-india` (10, ch. 9 «The Viceroy of India»), `thousand-miles` (11, ch. 10 «A Thousand Miles»), `to-drakmar` (12, ch. 11 «To Drakmar»), `upper-house` (13, ch. 12 «The Upper House»). Each stage record: `summary`, `keeper_info`, `hook`, `advice`, `steps` with `refs`, `conclusion` (incl. Sanity rewards), `tables`; scenes have `arc` = {scenario: the stage, part: the book's section heading, order}. - File prefixes (every book-scoped record except characters and stages): `campaign-` (introduction), `prologue-`, `madman-`, `park-`, `springer-`, `flight-`, `carcosa-`, `talk-`, `nug-`, `milan-` (ch. 8), `ship-` (ch. 9), `india-` (ch. 10), `drakmar-` (ch. 11), `house-` (ch. 12), `appendix-`. Slugs from the English names (6e book), e.g. `madman-st-agnes-asylum`. - Characters: `lokhmotya-korolya-ru/character/`, no prefix (they cross chapters). A character is made by the unit whose pages print his statblock first (the book: «статистика приводится там, где персонаж впервые встречается»); other units link and send changes through proposals. Fixed: intro — `talbot-estus`, `michael-gillen`, `jean-hewart`, `george-keith`, `hannah-keith`, `walter-paige`; madman — `charles-highsmith`, `montague-edwards` (alias Майкл Эванс), `alexander-roby`, `lucius-harriwell`; park — `michael-coombs`, `lionel-trollope`, `grahame-roby`, `andrew-taylor`, `vincent-tuck`, `delia-morrison`, `peter-morrison`; springer-flight — `dick-blair`, `harold-jennings`, `lawrence-bacon`, `aleister-crowley`, `henry-lister`; carcosa — `quentin-spence`, `noss`, `yolanda`; goatswood — `wilfred-gresty`, `hillary-quarrie`, `will`, `atkinson`; milan-ship — `paulo-tuminardo`, `thomas-villiers`, `giuseppe-colombo`, `ian-gore`, `julian-knight`, `henrietta-tullis`, `francesca-nicholson`, `patricia-berry`, `stephen-thomas`; india — `sivakumar-patel`, `jigme-rinzing`; drakmar — `tsewan-pemba`, `carlo-schippone`; house — `malcolm-quarrie`, `roberto-anzalone`. Unnamed groups (cultists, Tcho-Tcho, porters, ghouls #1–#5) — one record per group with the numbered stat lines as printed. - Organizations: `…/organization/campaign-cult-of-hastur` (intro, «Культ Хастура» p. 17), `…/organization/nug-goat-cult` (goatswood, Atkinson's Cult of the Goat), `…/organization/milan-brothers-of-the-yellow-sign` (milan-ship, Il Fratelli del Signo Giallo). The Golden Dawn and the Tcho-Tcho of Mustang — by the unit that describes them, only if the text gives them more than a mention. - Mythos already in the base — link, never duplicate: creatures `coc:creature:hastur`, `king-in-yellow`, `spawn-of-hastur`, `byakhee`, `ghoul`, `dark-young-of-shub-niggurath`, `shub-niggurath`, `nug-and-yeb`, `ygolonac`, `glaaki`, `shantak`, `chaugnar-faugn`, `miri-nigri`; tomes `coc:tome:king-in-yellow`, `revelations-of-glaaki`; spells `coc:spell:call-dismiss-hastur`, `contact-hastur`, `summon-bind-byakhee`, `summon-bind-dark-young`, `contact-ghoul`, `send-dream`, `evil-eye`, `unspeakable-promise`, `yellow-sign`… (Grep `kb/spells`, `kb/tomes`, `kb/creatures` first). A known creature with its own numbers in this book → book-scoped creature with `instance_of` the shared one. **New spells and tomes** printed in your pages (Build Carcosa p. 49 → madman; Bespeak the End of the Day p. 73 and Alexander Roby's book → park; the Turner Codex → springer-flight) — create them as new shared files `kb/spells/.json`, `kb/tomes/.json` (English slug, only after a Grep shows they do not exist); anything else shared — proposals. ### Places (Р-190, Р-209) - Shared cities `kb/locations/.json` (id `coc:location:`, `location_type: город`, `part_of: null`, model `kb/locations/kingsport.json`). **Existing — never rewrite, add only through proposals:** `london` (much text from «Маски» and «Pax Cthuliana»; London places of this book are book records with `part_of: coc:location:london`), `carcosa` (the city of Hastur; Carcosa's quarters of ch. 5 are book records `carcosa-…` with `part_of: coc:location:carcosa`), `bristol`. **New, each made only by its unit:** `hereford` (madman), `clare-melford` (village in Suffolk, springer-flight), `inverness` (springer-flight), `clotton` and `goatswood` (Severn valley villages, goatswood), `milan` (milan-ship), `bombay` and `benares` (india), `plateau-of-leng` (`location_type: область`, «Плато Ленг», house). A unit that needs a city of another unit links its id (expected to fail until it lands) and writes no copy. - Places outside a city — one area «Окрестности <города>» per city (`location_type: область`, book record): `madman-hereford-environs` (if the asylum stands outside Hereford), `flight-inverness-environs` (springer-flight; Cannich, Loch Mullardoch and the valley of the monoliths of ch. 5 go under it — carcosa unit), `nug-clotton-environs` (goatswood; Nug's farm, Mercy Hill, the woods). Nepal: `india-western-nepal` («Западный Непал и долина Кали-Гандаки», `область`, `part_of: null`, india unit) holds the route places of ch. 10–11 (Nautanwa, Butwal, Tansen, Pokhara, Kag, Tayen…: a record only if the text describes something there, else a line in the stage `steps`); `drakmar-drakmar-valley` (drakmar, `part_of` the region) holds Drakmar, its monastery and caves; the Upper House is `house-upper-house` (`здание`, `part_of: coc:location:plateau-of-leng`). Ships — `location_type: корабль`, `part_of: null` (Р-189): `ship-viceroy-of-india` (milan-ship). Under each city — districts by the map, places in the district where they stand on the map; list captions (`keeper_hint`) neutral, no secrets, clues or outcomes (Р-209). ### Maps (Р-206) `map` record `lokhmotya-korolya-ru/map/-` with the image: render the page (`pdftoppm -r 200 -f

-l

-png`), crop to the map with PIL, save `app/maps/tatters--.jpg` (quality 85, ≤ 2000 px wide), `width`/`height` of the image, `location` = the city or area, `shows` = the place it shows; **spots on every printed number and label** (find them with `tesseract … tsv`, check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record (`number`, `part_of` by the map). Map pages found: 22 (theatre «Scala»), 43 and 45 (St Agnes asylum and around it), 64 (St James's Park), 88–89 (Springer Mound, Jennings farm, the monoliths), 97 (Lawrence Bacon's house), 170 (Clotton and Goatswood), 180 (Nug's farm), 206 (Villiers' workshop), 231 (Bombay), 237 (Western Nepal), 265 and 269 (Drakmar, the monastery Te), 279 (the caves / the Upper House) — look at every picture of your pages, there may be more. ### Handouts The player handouts «Раздаточный материал «Лохмотья Короля» #N» are printed in Appendix H, pp. 328–359 (many as pictures: read the image; the newspaper texts may be only there); some are also in the chapter text. Each is made by the unit whose chapter uses it: intro #1–#4, madman #5–#7, park #8–#11, springer-flight #12–#17, carcosa #18–#19, goatswood #20–#24, milan-ship #25–#27, india #28, drakmar #29–#30 (Carlo Schippone's diary: chapter text pp. 270–273 and Appendix H pp. 356–359). Slug `-handout--`; the text as printed in Russian; the picture of an image handout goes to `images` (crop it from the page render, add it with `pipeline/art/add_images.py` → `app/art/handouts/`, Р-165). Read your Appendix H pages too (add them to your page list). ### Writing - Dice with lowercase d everywhere, even in quotes (`1d10/1d100`, Р-27); distances, heights and weights in metric even in quotes (the book keeps miles, feet, yards and pounds of the original — convert, Р-64); money as printed (£/s/d). - Statblocks as printed (Р-25): the Russian edition gives 7e values. Book misprints — keep as printed and add `errata` (Р-35); a changed value goes to `corrections`. - `axes.era` ["1920s"] (the campaign runs October 1928 – March 1930), `axes.ruleset` "core". - Coverage: `checks/20261113-tatters/.md` — every heading of your pages → record(s), «не взято» with the reason; proposals: `checks/20261113-tatters/proposals-.json`. Keep scratch files in your own scratchpad subfolder named after your unit; run tools as `python -B …`. - Order: intro first (campaign and stage ids are fixed, the others may run in parallel with it); appendices last — it links the dreams and timelines to the records of the chapter units.
